o: Founders Caroline & Guillaume Langloy; Kreaxi, regional family offices, Foodara

o: Founders Riad Dhaouadi & Guillaume Martin de Chamas (Chamas Group; franchise network)

o: Kitsuné group: founders Gildas Loaëc & Masaya Kuroki; Stripe International (Japanese apparel group, minority); Siparex mezzanine

o: Founder Frédéric Vaucamps (majority in each shop, with local partners)

o: Valentin Bauer and partner-associates

o: McWin Restaurant Fund (majority); founders Klaus Rader & Friedemann Findeis (minority)

o: Love & Food Restaurant Holding (McWin co-founders Henry McGovern & Steve Winegar, Sinclair Beecham); French master franchise held by Salvatore Perri

o: Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group (Jardine Matheson group), hotel operator

o: Hyatt Hotels Corporation (NYSE: H), hotel operator

o: Hyatt Hotels Corporation (NYSE: H), hotel operator

o: Founders Alexis Gagnaire & Antoine Vayson de Pradenne; Sanso Excellence (Sanso Longchamp AM) private equity fund

o: Barreteau family (majority) and employees; Crédit Mutuel Equity and other financial investors (minority)

o: Founder Haytam Boubtane (Five Original Corporation; franchise network)

o: Founder Marc Vanhove (franchise network)

o: Desobry family (Belgaufre), franchise network

o: Carole & Pierre Stupfel (100% via their holding; franchise network)

o: Founder Mohamed Soualhi (franchise network)

o: Daniel Sommer's group (also controls Speed Rabbit Pizza); franchise network

o: Experimental Group: founders Romée de Goriainoff, Olivier Bon, Pierre-Charles Cros and Jean Moueix (majority); Brookfield Asset Management and Bpifrance (minority)

o: Cotti Coffee (China), via its subsidiary Cotti Coffee France

o: V3 Gourmet (Singapore; Taha Bouqdib and billionaire Ron Sim), also owner of TWG Tea

o: Arts et Biens (investment holding) with the founders
note: Paris's pioneering gourmet burger food truck (2011, chef Kristin Frederick). Investment holding Arts et Biens put money in through capital increases in 2014 and 2016 to open fixed restaurants and still lists it in its portfolio (about €5m revenue in 2023).

o: Lagardère Travel Retail (Lagardère group, controlled by Vivendi/Bolloré)

o: Yamazaki Baking Co. (Tokyo-listed), via Yamazaki France SAS
note: Pâtisserie and tea room at La Muette run since 1988 by Yamazaki France, a subsidiary listed in the group structure of Japan's largest bakery company, Yamazaki Baking.

o: Calzedonia Group (Veronesi family)
note: Italian wine-shop-and-restaurant chain created in 2012 by Calzedonia founder Sandro Veronesi. Its first Paris site opened in December 2023 on three floors of a place Saint-Michel building that Calzedonia had bought for its French subsidiary.

o: Capdesia Group and Quadrivio & Pambianco's Made in Italy Fund II (co-leads), with co-investors incl. CVC-controlled Pergolesi
note: Rome pizza-by-the-slice chain (1989, about 230 shops).
